MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  JUNE 17, 2019

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates
  was called to order at 6:04 p.m. in Ernie Howlett Park, 25851 Hawthorne, Rolling Hills Estates,
  California by CHAIR RETZ.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR RETZ led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Retz, Persichina, McCormick, Romanelli, Ciarolla,
  Bain

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Pope

  STAFF PRESENT:  Alexa Davis, Assistant to City Manager
  Michael Goldsmith, Maintenance Superintendent
  Daniel A-Haja, Community Services Coordinator

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF
  MAY 20, 2019

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK
  to:

  APPROVE THE PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF MAY 20,
  2019.

  There being no objection, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  None

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  There being no items on the Consent Calendar, COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion,
  seconded by COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROJECT

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  1
JUNE 17, 2019
   CHAIR RETZ asked about the effect the Cal Water project would have on the Spinning
  Wheel Lane project, Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith noted they will notify
  Cal Water to move the water meter to the front of the entryway for a simple drip line
  irrigation system which would be used for approximately one year to establish the plants.
  Afterwards, little to no water will be used on the drought tolerant California native plants
  which populate the entryway.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI suggested the use of City beautification funds be used to
  assist Renee’ Soiffer’s beautification project. Maintenance Superintendent Goldsmith
  noted that the resident wanted to fund the entire project without grant funds.

  VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI

  There being no objection, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  8.  ADJOURN TO THE PEPPERTREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING

  CHAIR RETZ made a motion

  ADOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING

  A.  TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TOURNAMENT CONCESSION SIGN-UP SHEET

  Community Services Coordinator stated that the spots were still needed for Saturday and
  Sunday shifts.

  COMMISSIONER CIAROLLA signed up for Saturday 9 A.M. – 1 P.M. and
  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK signed up for Sunday 9 A.M. – 12 P.M.

  B.  TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TOURNAMENT SUBCOMMITTEE UPDATE

  COMMMISSIONER MCCORMICK suggested sending letters to the Chamber of
  Commerce to increase sponsorship opportunities and to reach out to The Jack Kramer
  Club for more volunteers.

  CHAIR RETZ suggested having a permanent sponsorship tab on the City website for
  businesses to have access to donate for future events.

  Daniel A-Haja notified the Commission that invitations to the VIP luncheon will be sent the
  first week of July and that a t-shirt design was finalized at the sub-committee meeting held
  earlier that evening. An update on sponsors was also provided.

  9.  RECONVENE TO PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING

  CHAIR RETZ made a motion,

  RECONVENE TO THE PARK AND ACITIVITIES COMMITTEE MEETING

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  2
JUNE 17, 2019
   There being no objection, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  10.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORTS

  CHAIR RETZ provided the following issues to be addressed on P.V. Drive North:

  •  Trees in the center divider are being girdled

  Maintenance Superintendent Goldsmith stated that the girdling is normal and that they will
  be fixed as the trees take root.

  CHAIR BAIN provided the following issues to be addressed at Highridge Park:

  •  Erosion is much better and seems to be resolved;
  •  Graffiti on wall near bathroom is still present;
  •  Bathroom and bulletin board still look in shabby condition

  Maintenance Superintendent Goldsmith stated that the graffiti will be looked into and that
  the bathroom and bulletin board are currently planned in the coming months pending receipt of
  bids.

  B.  CITY CELEBRATION SUBCOMMITTEE MEETING UPDATE

  Community Services Coordinator A-Haja stated that the location of the Philharmonic and
  was finalized and notified the Commission of the Palos Verdes Library District’s project to archive
  the stories, photos, and documents of local Peninsula residents. A-Haja also noted the increase
  of cakes at the event and that staff is still gathering potential sponsors. Assistant to City Manager
  Davis also stated that local news promotion will be provided during the event through the
  coordination if subcommittee member Vicki Shinn.

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK asked if a sponsor’s packet was available which
  contained statistics and historical data on events. Community Services Coordinator A-Haja noted
  that the City has a packet for Pepper Tree Sponsorship levels, but that they do not contain
  statistics or historical data. It was suggested that one be drafted for future consideration.

  11.  DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (Verbal Reports)

  A.  NEW COMMUNITY SERVICES SUPERVISOR STARTS JUNE 25, 2019

  B.  BROWN ACT REVIEW WORKSHOP – JUNE 24, 2019

  C.  WEEKLY EMAIL TO COMMISSION WILL CONTINUE UNDER CURRENT STAFF

  12.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  3
JUNE 17, 2019
   A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF MAY 28 2019

  Received and filed

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JUNE 4, 2019

  Received and filed

  C.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JUNE 11, 2019

  Received and filed

  13.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  RE-NAMING “BUTCHER PARK”

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK stated he would forward his list, previously sent to retired
  Director Clark, to Community Services Coordinator A-Haja. CHAIR RETZ provided an
  additional name to be added to the list as Thunderhawk Hill.

  B.  51 HIDDEN VALLEY ROAD REPLACEMENT TREE SPECIES

  Commission directed staff to have the Palos Verdes Land Conservancy review the existing
  list of replacement trees with the consideration of moving toward native species.

  C.  TABOR GROVE

  The Commission directed staff to return to the neighborhood with comprehensive project
  overview, including the newly added scenic corridor, and bring the item back for final
  review and approval by the Commission. COMMISSIONER BAIN noted that concern has
  rose since resident found out on encroachment on property. Coordinator A-Haja
  suggested looking at past HOA minutes to confirm their approval.

  D.  PARK DEVELOPMENT TIMELINE

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK requested that staff provide a timeline of park projects
  that are pending development.

  14.  PARK TOURS

  The Park and Activities Commission toured Ernie Howlett Park and noted the following:

  •  Some signs are faded; staff has already ordered replacements
  •  Bathrooms will receive newly painted flooring in upcoming months
  •  New shed was placed at the Little League Fields; staff will follow-up with the Little
  League to confirm if approval was sought
  •  Sponsor signs along field fences need to be removed

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  4
JUNE 17, 2019
   •  Drinking fountain by the fields are non-working; staff is seeking grant funds to
  replace the drinking fountain
  •  Weed abatement and brush clearance is in process.

  15.  ADJOURNMENT

  VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA made a motion, seconded by CHAIR RETZ to,

  ADJOURN THE MEETING AT 7:19 PM TO THE NEXT ADJOURNED PARK AND
  ACTIVITIES MEETING ON JULY 15, 2019 AT 6:00 P.M., WHICH WILL MEET
  AT HIGHRIDGE PARK, 29035 HIGHRIDGE ROAD., ROLLING HILLS
  ESTATES.

  There being no objection, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  __________________________  _____________________________
  Daniel A-Haja  Alexa Davis
  Community Services Coordinator  Assistant to City Manager

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES,  5
JUNE 17, 2019
